description: This Scala source file defines custom exception classes related to missing database objects (databases, schemas, tables, views, functions, indexes) within Apache Spark's SQL Catalyst analysis module. It includes classes like NoSuchDatabaseException, NoSuchTableException, and others, each providing specific error handling for not found items.

classes.name: NoSuchDatabaseException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a database cannot be found.

classes.name: NoSuchNamespaceException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a namespace (schema) cannot be found.

classes.name: NoSuchTableException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a table or view cannot be found.

classes.name: NoSuchViewException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a view cannot be found.

classes.name: NoSuchPermanentFunctionException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a permanent function cannot be found.

classes.name: NoSuchFunctionException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a function cannot be found.

classes.name: NoSuchTempFunctionException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a temporary function cannot be found.

classes.name: NoSuchIndexException
classes.description: Exception thrown when an index cannot be found.

classes.name: CannotReplaceMissingTableException
classes.description: Exception indicating a missing table that cannot be replaced.

methods.name: constructor methods for each class
methods.description: Various constructors for initializing the exception classes with specific error details.
